rules.clause_text: Delinquency. No scheduled payment on the Receivable is more than 30 days past due.
rules.plain_english: A loan is ineligible if any scheduled payment is more than 30 days past due at the cut-off date. Up to and including 30 days past due passes.

rules.clause_text: Status. The Receivable has not been charged off and the related Financed Vehicle has not been repossessed.
rules.plain_english: A loan that has been charged off, or whose vehicle has been repossessed, is ineligible.

rules.clause_text: Term. The original term of the Receivable is 84 months or less.
rules.plain_english: The original term must be 84 months or less.

rules.clause_text: Credit score. The Obligor's FICO score at origination is 540 or higher.
rules.plain_english: The obligor's FICO score at origination must be 540 or higher.

rules.clause_text: Balance. The Outstanding Balance of the Receivable does not exceed US$75,000.
rules.plain_english: The outstanding balance must not exceed US$75,000.

rules.clause_text: Location. The Obligor's billing address is in one of the fifty states of the United States or the District of Columbia.
rules.plain_english: The obligor's billing address must be in one of the fifty US states or the District of Columbia. The tape has obligor_state, not a separate billing address field; obligor_state is used as the closest field.

rules.clause_text: Restricted Jurisdictions. The Obligor's billing address is not in a Restricted Jurisdiction.
rules.plain_english: The obligor's billing address must not be in a Restricted Jurisdiction. The list of Restricted Jurisdictions is not in the material provided, so the test cannot be populated until that definition is obtained.

rules.clause_text: Modifications. The terms of the Receivable have been modified no more than once since origination.
rules.plain_english: The loan may have been modified at most once since origination.

rules.clause_text: Annual percentage rate. The annual percentage rate of the Receivable is not less than 6.00% and not more than 29.99%.
rules.plain_english: The APR must be between 6.00% and 29.99%, both inclusive.

rules.clause_text: Vehicle age. The model year of the Financed Vehicle is no more than ten years before the year of origination of the Receivable.
rules.plain_english: The vehicle's model year must be no more than ten years before the year the loan was originated (compare model_year with the year of origination_date).

rules.clause_text: Seasoning. The Obligor has made at least one scheduled payment on the Receivable.
rules.plain_english: The obligor must have made at least one scheduled payment.

rules.clause_text: Unique collateral. The Financed Vehicle is identified by a Vehicle Identification Number that appears on no other Receivable in the Pool.
rules.logic: vin appears once in the tape
rules.plain_english: The vehicle's VIN must not appear on any other loan in the pool; a repeated VIN suggests the car was pledged twice.

rules.clause_text: Obligors with a billing address in any one state
rules.plain_english: Loans to obligors billed in any one state may make up at most 20% of the Eligible Pool Balance; any excess is an excess concentration.

rules.clause_text: Receivables originated by any one Dealer, treating Dealers under common ownership or trading under variations of one name as one Dealer
rules.plain_english: Loans originated by any one dealer may make up at most 5% of the Eligible Pool Balance. Dealers under common ownership or trading under variations of one name count as one dealer.

rules.clause_text: Receivables with an original term of more than 72 months
rules.plain_english: Loans with an original term of more than 72 months (strictly greater than 72) may make up at most 25% of the Eligible Pool Balance.

rules.clause_text: Receivables secured by used Financed Vehicles
rules.logic: share(vehicle_condition in used_conditions) <= 70% of eligible pool
rules.plain_english: Loans secured by used vehicles may make up at most 70% of the Eligible Pool Balance.

rules.clause_ref: Schedule 2, row 5 (added by Amendment No. 1, Section 2(b))
rules.clause_text: Receivables with an Obligor FICO score at origination below 600
rules.plain_english: From 1 March 2026, loans whose obligor's FICO score at origination is below 600 (strictly less than 600) may make up at most 35% of the Eligible Pool Balance. Added by Amendment No. 1; it applies to Borrowing Base Certificates for Collection Periods ending on or after 1 March 2026, and the Amendment itself takes effect only once the conditions in its Section 3 are met.

concept.label: Commitment
concept.meaning: The facility limit, the most the lender has committed to lend.

concept.label: Advance rate
concept.meaning: The share of the eligible pool, after excess concentration, that the lender will advance.

concept.label: Eligibility criterion
concept.meaning: A test every receivable must pass. A receivable that fails any test is excluded in full.

concept.label: Concentration limit
concept.meaning: The most of the eligible pool that one group of receivables may make up, such as one originator or one state.

concept.label: Excess concentration
concept.meaning: The amount by which a group of receivables exceeds its concentration limit.

terms.name: Excess concentration treatment
terms.value: Deducted from Eligible Pool Balance before Advance Rate

concept.label: Reserve
concept.meaning: An amount held back from the borrowing base, set as a share of the eligible pool.

concept.label: Delinquency trigger
concept.meaning: A pool test on the share of receivables past due. A breach stops new advances.

concept.label: Tangible net worth covenant
concept.meaning: The least tangible net worth the sponsor must keep.

concept.label: Leverage covenant
concept.meaning: The highest leverage ratio the sponsor may reach.

concept.label: Liquidity covenant
concept.meaning: The least unrestricted cash the sponsor must hold.

terms.clause: Section 1.1, definition of Restricted Jurisdiction; Schedule 4

concept.label: Restricted jurisdiction
concept.meaning: A place where an obligor's billing address makes the receivable ineligible.

terms.name: Restricted jurisdictions

concept.label: Margin
concept.meaning: The interest the borrower pays over the benchmark rate.

concept.label: Unused fee
concept.meaning: A yearly fee on the part of the commitment that is not drawn.

concept.label: Interest period
concept.meaning: How long each interest period runs, and the day interest is paid.

terms.name: Interest period and payment date
terms.value: One month; 15th of each calendar month

concept.label: Reporting obligation
concept.meaning: A covenant to deliver something to the lender, such as financial statements, by a set date.

terms.name: Borrowing base reporting date
terms.value: 15th Business Day after each calendar month end

concept.label: Reporting obligation
concept.meaning: A covenant to deliver something to the lender, such as financial statements, by a set date.

terms.name: Financial statement reporting
terms.value: Quarterly within 45 days; annual within 120 days

concept.label: Revolving period
concept.meaning: The period in which the borrower may draw and repay. New advances stop at its end.

terms.name: Revolving period end

terms.clause: Section 1.1, definition of Final Maturity Date

concept.label: Final maturity
concept.meaning: The date by which every advance must be repaid.

terms.name: Final maturity

concept.label: Event of default
concept.meaning: An event that lets the lender stop lending and demand repayment.

concept.label: Alert threshold
concept.meaning: A level the lender asks to be told about when it is crossed, such as availability falling below a set amount.

concept.label: Borrower
concept.meaning: The company that borrows under the facility and owes every advance.
